'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Vikram Bali DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
